prompt_scope: artifact-only audit from calibration/dev evidence; held-out test prompts were not used

task_context.target: random/generalized prompts should stably exceed 5 tok/s on 16GB host RAM including page cache plus 32GB RTX 5090 VRAM
task_context.accepted_sota_rule: final accepted SOTA must be measured on held_out_test_set_v1_locked after candidate freeze and cannot use prompt-specific traces/packs/hotsets

exact_sidecar_gate.result: exact sidecar reproduced GGUF partial bytes with diff_count=0 and fixed-text same_top1=145/145; zero sidecar produced nonzero local diffs
exact_sidecar_gate.interpretation: sidecar loader and compare gate are useful, but exact sidecar has no compression benefit and lossy sidecar still requires compare/top1 proof

post_q2_codebook.result: q3/codebook variants reduce error but provide only about 1.31x compression and still have nonzero magnitude error

generalized_lowbit_bound.interpretation: zero-overhead hypothetical bounds are not correctness or runtime evidence

decision.reason: q2ternary and simple codebook sidecars do not pass op-level correctness; exact sidecar has no compression benefit; hypothetical lowbit bounds require correctness evidence before any runtime path

next_plan.first_step: artifact-only hard-bound/profile aggregation for prompt-general exact retained dataflow and source movement
next_plan.source_edit_gate: only edit source if dev-set exact bound shows min >= 5.5 tok/s or a concrete subpath can net-save at least 150 ms/token without violating TTFT/RAM/correctness
